# Import data

```{r }
library(dplyr)
## fetch the data
dataweek1_rep1 <- read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Batch5", "csv files", "Batch5Rep1_Week1_EggCounts.csv"), sep = ";", header=TRUE)
head(dataweek1_rep1)
dataweek1_rep2 <- read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Batch5", "csv files", "Batch5Rep2_Week1_EggCounts.csv"), sep = ";", header=TRUE)
head(dataweek1_rep2)
dataweek1_rep3 <- read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Batch5", "csv files", "Batch5Rep3_Week1_EggCounts.csv"), sep = ";", header=TRUE)
head(dataweek1_rep3)
dataweek2_rep1 <- read.table(file=file.path(here::here(),"data", "raw_data", "Batch5", "csv files", "Batch5Rep1_Week2_EggCounts.csv"), sep = ";", header=TRUE)
head(dataweek2_rep1)
dataweek2_rep2 <- read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Batch5", "csv files", "Batch5Rep2_Week2_EggCounts.csv"), sep = ";", header=TRUE)
head(dataweek2_rep2)

## Convert dataframe into tibble
library(magrittr)
dataweek1_rep1 <- tibble::as_tibble(dataweek1_rep1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=as.factor(replicate), PetriNumber =as.factor(PetriNumber))
dataweek1_rep2 <- tibble::as_tibble(dataweek1_rep2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=as.factor(replicate), PetriNumber =as.factor(PetriNumber))
dataweek1_rep3 <- tibble::as_tibble(dataweek1_rep3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=3) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=as.factor(replicate), PetriNumber =as.factor(PetriNumber))
dataweek2_rep1 <- tibble::as_tibble(dataweek2_rep1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=as.factor(replicate), PetriNumber =as.factor(PetriNumber))
dataweek2_rep2 <- tibble::as_tibble(dataweek2_rep2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(replicate=as.factor(replicate), PetriNumber =as.factor(PetriNumber))

## Enlever les lignes na ds dataweek1_rep2
## Garder ds  dataweek1 uniquyement les BP présentes ds dataweek1_rep2
## dataweek1_rep2$EggCount
dataweek1_rep2 <- dataweek1_rep2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(EggCount))
dataweek1_rep3 <- dataweek1_rep3 %>%
  filter(!is.na(EggCount))

## merge the tibbles into 1 tibble
dataweek <- rbind(dataweek1_rep1, dataweek1_rep2, dataweek1_rep3, dataweek2_rep1, dataweek2_rep2) %>%
  filter(PetriNumber %in% dataweek1_rep3$PetriNumber)  %>% 
  droplevels()


```
# plot correlation between the two measurements
```{r}
library(tidyr)
dataweek %>%
  select(PetriNumber, replicate, EggCount)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = replicate, values_from = EggCount)%>%
          ggplot(aes(x=`1`, y=`3`)) +
          geom_point() +
          geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope=1, linetype="dotted", color = "pink", linewidth=1) +
  labs(x = "replicate 1", y = "replicate 3")

```
# estimate repeatability with the ANOVA funtion

```{r} 
## Number of replicate per individual
table(dataweek$PetriNumber)

## Fit model with ANOVA
fit1 <- aov(EggCount ~ PetriNumber, data = dataweek)
summary(fit1)

## Number of replicates per individual
n0=table(dataweek$PetriNumber)[1]
n_ind=nrow(dataweek1_rep3)
## Degrees of freedom = number of individual - 1
df_Among <- n_ind-1

## Sum of squares among individuals
SSA <- summary(fit1)[[1]]$`Sum Sq`[1] 

## Among-groups (ie individual) variance component
MSA <- SSA/df_Among

## residual degrees of freedom
dfRes <- n_ind*(n0-1) 

## Sum of squares among replicates
SSW <- summary(fit1)[[1]]$`Sum Sq`[2] 

## Within-group variance component = Residual variance
(VarWithin <- SSW/dfRes)

## Check that the value computed by R is the same
sigma(fit1)^2

## Among individual variance 
(VarAmong<- (MSA-VarWithin)/n0)

## Observed repeatability
(Repeatability <- VarAmong/(VarAmong+VarWithin))

```
# Estimate repeatability by hand

```{r }
## 1. Compute the error of each measurement under the complete model, i.e. the difference between each measurement and the mean of two measurements of the same individual
## Compute the squared error of each measurement (complete model
library(dplyr)
complete <- dataweek %>%  
  group_by(PetriNumber) %>% 
  mutate(mean_Eggcount = mean(EggCount)) %>% #in complete model, fit is the group mean (i.e. mean of each individual) 
  mutate(error = mean_Eggcount - EggCount) %>% 
  mutate(sq_error = error ^ 2) %>%
  ungroup()

## Compute the N, the total number of observations and the SSE, the sum of the squared error of each measurement
## Compute n, the number of groups in the complete model (ie. individuals in the dataset)
## Compute df2, the residual degrees of freedom
(complete <- complete %>% 
  summarise(N = n(), sse = sum(sq_error)) %>% 
  mutate(n = length(unique(dataweek$PetriNumber))) %>% 
  mutate(df2 = N - n) %>% 
  select(sse, df2, N, n) %>% 
  mutate(mse = sse / df2) # mse = sigma squared 
)

## Check that the value computed by R is the same
sigma(fit1)^2

## 2. Reduced fit model
## Compute the error of each measurement according to the reduced model, i.e. the difference between each measurement and the overall mean across all measurements in the dataset
## Compute the squared error of each measurement (reduced model)
reduced <- dataweek %>%  
  mutate(mean_EggCount = mean(EggCount)) %>% #in reduced model, fit is the overall mean 
  mutate(error = mean_EggCount - EggCount) %>% 
  mutate(sq_error = error ^ 2) %>%
  ungroup() 

## Compute the N, the total number of observations and the SSE, the sum of the squared error of each measurement
## Compute n, the number of groups in the reduced model (ie. 1 for the overall mean)
## Compute df2, the residual degrees of freedom
(reduced <- reduced %>% 
  summarise(N = n(), sse = sum(sq_error)) %>% # sse = sum square error
  mutate(n = 1) %>% 
  mutate(df2 = N - n) %>% 
  select(sse, df2, N, n)
)

## 3.Compute the SSA, df and MSA explained by the complete model
## Residual variance of the reduced model explained by the complete model
(explained_ssa <- reduced$sse - complete$sse)

## df1 = number of groups (ie. individuals) - 1 (for the overall mean)
(explained_df1 <- reduced$df2 - complete$df2)

## MSA = SSA/df1
(explained_msa <- explained_ssa / explained_df1)

## Fratio = MSA/MSE
(f <- explained_msa / complete$mse)

## Compute P-value
pf(f, explained_df1, complete$df2, lower.tail = FALSE)

## 4. Compute the repeatability 
## Number of replicates
num_rep <- complete$N/complete$n

## Within individual variance
(VarWithin <- complete$mse)

## Among individual variance 
(VarAmong<- (explained_msa-complete$mse)/num_rep)

## Observed repeatability
(Repeatability <- VarAmong/(VarAmong+VarWithin))

```
